data.one_liner: Apple App Store Server SDK for facilitating integrations with App Store Server API.
data.what_it_does: Facilitates integrations with the App Store Server API. Allows getting transaction history, subscription statuses, sending consumption information, looking up order IDs, getting refund history, extending subscription renewal dates, and verifying receipts.
use_when: You need to integrate with the App Store Server API from your backend or Dart application
You need to verify iTunes receipts
You need to check subscription statuses and transaction history
avoid_when: You only need client-side in-app purchases using standard Flutter plugins
You are looking for Google Play billing integrations
strengths: Provides built-in methods for Apple App Store Server API features
Supports receipt verification via iTunes API
weaknesses: Requires manual API keys configuration from Apple
Limited documentation outside of README and official Apple links
data.setup_notes: Requires creating API keys to use with the App Store Server API as instructed by Apple documentation.
